items.text: Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between curious follow and random play states.
Improved skateboard cow stability to prevent frequent falls.
Corrected swapped appearances between inbred and non‑inbred cows.
Enhanced animal avoidance logic; animals now avoid obstacles more reliably (performance to be optimized).

Comprehensive sheep shearing overhaul: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool counts as harvest and goes to backpack, fur baking runs only on fleece models, updated tests and manifest restored.
Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
Added new bull and cow trophy models to hunting trophy collection.
Respawnable fridges now assign a new "first looter" after items respawn.
Loadout items now retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.
Grenades now support mask interactions, affecting visibility and targeting.
Introduced unique subsystems for water pistols and keycards, removing unnecessary holdtypes.

Shearing now uses any item capable of harvesting corpses, simplifying the mechanic and fixing bugs where shaved sheep corpses lost their state or flopped in the air; includes a new shearing material and gameplay proof of concept.
Meat items formerly called "Lamb" are renamed to "Mutton" for raw, cooked, and spoiled versions, aligning names with in‑game terminology.
Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources, and pregnancies are blocked unless the cow's condition is at least 60%, preventing unintended resource generation.

Crab swarms now move as cohesive groups with random size‑influenced speeds, improved fleeing and startle reactions, and idle movement integration, fixing pathing and making swarm behavior more realistic.
Added dedicated subsystems for megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, and master key, removing unnecessary override controllers and enabling proper functionality of these player tools.
Boat vendor dialogue on floating cities now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat, fixing misleading instructions.
Livestock interaction popup is repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and preventing the livestock model from being hidden during interaction.
Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn, fixing loot ownership bugs.
Tool Cupboards are no longer hidden by room occlusion, allowing players to see and verify TC status.
Item positions are saved and restored when creating or deploying loadouts, preserving layout.
Ladder hatch functionality has been fixed, improving their reliability and use.

Sheep shearing has been overhauled: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as a shot, knives wound instead of shearing, wool payout matches the authored amount, timers resume correctly on load, wool is harvested to the backpack, fur baking runs only on fleece models, wild sheep can be attempted to shave (they run away), and the shaved state carries over to corpses with correct pose.
Wild cows can no longer breed, age, or produce resources, and they can only become pregnant if their condition is at least 60%.
New bull and cow trophy models have been added to the large hunting trophy prefab.
Crab swarms have been introduced with group pathing and size‑influenced random speeds, enhancing hostile critter encounters.
Fleeing and startle mechanics for critters have been improved, making them react more realistically to threats.
Boat vendor dialogue on floating cities now correctly indicates the direction to find the purchased boat.
NaN water height issue resolved, preventing water surface glitches that could affect navigation and building.

2026-09-18.summary:
### Loot & Base Building
- Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn, fixing loot ownership bugs.
- Tool Cupboards are no longer hidden by room occlusion, allowing players to see and verify TC status.

### Loadouts & Items
- Item positions are saved and restored when creating or deploying loadouts, preserving layout.
- Ladder hatch functionality has been fixed, improving their reliability and use.

### Animals & Shearing
- Sheep shearing has been overhauled: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as a shot, knives wound instead of shearing, wool payout matches the authored amount, timers resume correctly on load, wool is harvested to the backpack, fur baking runs only on fleece models, wild sheep can be attempted to shave (they run away), and the shaved state carries over to corpses with correct pose.
- Wild cows can no longer breed, age, or produce resources, and they can only become pregnant if their condition is at least 60%.
- New bull and cow trophy models have been added to the large hunting trophy prefab.

### Creatures & AI
- Crab swarms have been introduced with group pathing and size‑influenced random speeds, enhancing hostile critter encounters.
- Fleeing and startle mechanics for critters have been improved, making them react more realistically to threats.

### UI & World
- Boat vendor dialogue on floating cities now correctly indicates the direction to find the purchased boat.
- NaN water height issue resolved, preventing water surface glitches that could affect navigation and building.

items.text: Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, fixing a limitation where they only reacted to client projectiles.
Distance2D calculations now correctly use true 2‑D distance, fixing range‑related bugs.
Low‑health heartbeat sound now ramps up with intensity and fades after 3 seconds of health loss, making danger more noticeable.
Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant extra duration, higher yield, healing, max HP and other buffs.
Brioche Bread recipe adds a 25 % boost to bread stats and requires eggs and cream.
Key recipe costs reduced (stone and cloth) and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.
Water‑level generation no longer produces NaN values, eliminating water‑height glitches.
Triangle foundations no longer incorrectly connect buildings that only touch at a corner.
Seat‑swap action added across all vehicle controls and a consistent car reload button binding introduced.
Stirring a biofuel generator mounts the player at their position; releasing E stops mounting, and a ‘no electricity’ status appears if the generator lacks power.
Livestock spread out when feeding to avoid crowding the trough, and sheep corpse colliders now behave correctly.
Navmesh generation issues fixed, preventing meshes on fences and improving NPC pathing.
New achievements added for mailing a note to another player, buying from the travelling vendor, and triggering a satellite crash event.
Quick join menu now reliably shows server entries without disappearing.
Quick join menu now displays entries (previously empty).
Painting UI now includes a colour wheel for neon signs, larger size option (up to 25mm), and optional brush outline toggle for better visibility.
Sheep charge attack animation fixed, ensuring proper attack behavior.
Toggle duck feature works correctly on non-modular car vehicles.
Flexbox UI layout error resolved, preventing out-of-range crashes in UI panels.

2026-09-17.summary:
### Combat & Targeting
- Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, fixing a limitation where they only reacted to client projectiles.
- Distance2D calculations now correctly use true 2‑D distance, fixing range‑related bugs.
- Low‑health heartbeat sound now ramps up with intensity and fades after 3 seconds of health loss, making danger more noticeable.

### Crafting & Food Buffs
- Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant extra duration, higher yield, healing, max HP and other buffs.
- Brioche Bread recipe adds a 25 % boost to bread stats and requires eggs and cream.
- Key recipe costs reduced (stone and cloth) and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.

### World & Environment
- Water‑level generation no longer produces NaN values, eliminating water‑height glitches.
- Triangle foundations no longer incorrectly connect buildings that only touch at a corner.

### Vehicles & Controls
- Seat‑swap action added across all vehicle controls and a consistent car reload button binding introduced.
- Stirring a biofuel generator mounts the player at their position; releasing E stops mounting, and a ‘no electricity’ status appears if the generator lacks power.

### Livestock & AI
- Livestock spread out when feeding to avoid crowding the trough, and sheep corpse colliders now behave correctly.
- Navmesh generation issues fixed, preventing meshes on fences and improving NPC pathing.

### Achievements
- New achievements added for mailing a note to another player, buying from the travelling vendor, and triggering a satellite crash event.

### Multiplayer & Matchmaking
- Quick join menu now reliably shows server entries without disappearing.
- Quick join menu now displays entries (previously empty).

### Building & Creative
- Painting UI now includes a colour wheel for neon signs, larger size option (up to 25mm), and optional brush outline toggle for better visibility.

### Combat & Animations
- Sheep charge attack animation fixed, ensuring proper attack behavior.

### Vehicle Controls
- Toggle duck feature works correctly on non-modular car vehicles.

### UI Stability
- Flexbox UI layout error resolved, preventing out-of-range crashes in UI panels.

items.text: Purchased animals keep their assigned gender and sheep can now be sheared to collect wool.

Animal interactions are more reliable: vendors show only the interacting player's animals, cows can feed from troughs even when blocked and avoid clipping with each other and players, critters no longer startle each other and react properly to nearby players, older animals have simplified AI, and bears immediately flee when the target stands on a foundation.

A new wool item can be sold to the stables vendor via the auction system (stack size 100, rewards scale with amount, 15‑minute cooldown after rejecting all offers) and a bug fixing multiple‑stack deductions.
Loot tables for Trainyard, Water Treatment, and Sewer branches have been rebalanced.
Added a monument trigger for the oil‑rig switch event and introduced new air‑drop and satellite selection events.
C4 now has improved client‑side prediction, hide/show event controls, and corrected rotation blending throughout its travel distance.
Only the default sandbag is craftable; other variants are now unavailable.

Sandbag stacking and upgrades were overhauled: upgrades can be applied immediately, retain the sandbag’s current health fraction, share a unified cooldown with repairs, include server‑side validation, and prevent clipping.

2026-09-16.summary:
### Livestock & Animal Mechanics
- Purchased animals keep their assigned gender and sheep can now be sheared to collect wool.
- Animal interactions are more reliable: vendors show only the interacting player's animals, cows can feed from troughs even when blocked and avoid clipping with each other and players, critters no longer startle each other and react properly to nearby players, older animals have simplified AI, and bears immediately flee when the target stands on a foundation.

### Wool Economy
- A new wool item can be sold to the stables vendor via the auction system (stack size 100, rewards scale with amount, 15‑minute cooldown after rejecting all offers) and a bug fixing multiple‑stack deductions.

### World Loot & Events
- Loot tables for Trainyard, Water Treatment, and Sewer branches have been rebalanced.
- Added a monument trigger for the oil‑rig switch event and introduced new air‑drop and satellite selection events.

### C4 Mechanics
- C4 now has improved client‑side prediction, hide/show event controls, and corrected rotation blending throughout its travel distance.

### Sandbag Defense & Upgrades
- Only the default sandbag is craftable; other variants are now unavailable.
- Sandbag stacking and upgrades were overhauled: upgrades can be applied immediately, retain the sandbag’s current health fraction, share a unified cooldown with repairs, include server‑side validation, and prevent clipping.
